text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between Liverpool and Bournemouth at Anfield!

Having drawn 1-1 with Chelsea in their first match of the new Premier League season, Liverpool enter this contest unbeaten in their last 12 top-flight fixtures - and they have not lost at Anfield for the same number of games.
This time last year, Jurgen Klopp's side tore through Bournemouth's defence in a 9-0 mauling, which equalled the Premier League's largest margin of victory.
Indeed, the Reds have won five of their six home league games against the Cherries.
Bournemouth held West Ham United to a 1-1 draw on the opening day, halting a four-game Premier League losing streak that ended their 2022-23 campaign.

As the Cherries successfully secured top-flight survival last term, they won three of their final five away fixtures, but they have never won at Anfield in any competition - a 2-2 draw in April 2017 was the only occasion they've avoided defeat.
Nevertheless, they avenged last August's 9-0 losss by beating Liverpool at the Vitality Stadium in the teams' most recent meeting.
Selecting an unchanged starting XI, Klopp names new signing Endo on the bench after the Japan captain's arrival on Friday.
Liverpool are still without Thiago Alcantara due to a hip injury, and Curtis Jones misses out with an ankle problem, but Bajcetic has now returned to the fold.
Vice-captain Alexander-Arnold makes his 200th Premier League appearance.
Andoni Iraola opts for one change from the Bournemouth side that started last week's draw with West Ham, as Brooks is replaced by Semenyo.
The latter supports former Liverpool striker Solanke up front.
New signing Tyler Adams is out injured, joining a lengthy list of absentees also featuring Alex Scott, Dango Ouattara and Ryan Fredericks.
The players are out on the pitch at Anfield, and kick-off is now just moments away!
Liverpool kick off, and we are under way on Merseyside!

Though the ball finds the back of the Liverpool net via Anthony's boot, following a mix-up involving Alisson and Konate, Bournemouth's early 'goal' is almost immediately ruled out for offside by the VAR.
The home side escape!

BOURNEMOUTH LEAD AT ANFIELD! Semenyo strikes unerringly into the bottom-right corner to put the Cherries in front! An error by Alexander-Arnold is not swept up by the Liverpool defence, and the Solanke prods the ball through a gap before Semenyo thumps it past Alisson: it's 1-0 to the visitors!
Seizing on a mistake by Liverpool's back four, Solanke steals the ball and turns it into the path of opening goalscorer Semenyo.

OFF THE BAR! Liverpool almost strike straight back! Meeting an outswinging corner by Robertson near the penalty spot, Van Dijk cleverly contrives a header that loops towards the goalframe and then bounces back and out of immediate danger! What a start at Anfield!
Having stumbled out of his area and been punished for some leaden-footed control, Alisson clips Anthony just outside the box and is booked by the referee.
Liverpool are just not at the races so far!
Twice, following his error just minutes ago, Alisson claims balls into the box with some authority, as Liverpool aim to settle down and recover from their jittery start to the match.
Bournemouth have begun brightly here.
SAVE! Alexander-Arnold seeks redemption for his part in Bournemouth's goal, but is just denied by Neto, who tips his rasping drive from the right byline wide for a corner.
Salah had played his colleague in with a neat exchange on the edge of the box, but Liverpool still trail.
There is more uncertainty in the Liverpool area now, as Van Dijk and Alisson can't agree on who should claim possession deep inside their own box.
The latter ultimately grasps the ball.
For ending a surging run forward by Gakpo, goalscorer Semenyo becomes the first Bournemouth player booked.
After a crossfield ball from Alexander-Arnold picks out Diaz on the edge of the area, the Colombian winger twice sees shots blocked before Szoboszlai slices an attempt wide of the right-hand post.
Liverpool are finding some rhythm now, as Salah lays the ball off for Gakpo around 20 yards out from goal, before the Netherlands international hammers a wayward shot over the crossbar.

text: Leaning back a little, Solanke fires well over from just outside the Liverpool area at the end of a quick Bournemouth counter-attack.
The visitors have continued to pose a threat since going in front.
Though he is ultimately flagged for offisde, Solanke causes more problems at the heart of Liverpool's defence with a forceful run and a neat combination with Billing.
He's clearly got a point to prove on his latest return to Anfield.
Neto gratefully clings on to the ball inside his six-yard box after a switch of passes between Mac Allister and Salah opens up space on the right-hand side of Bournemouth's box.
Following a forward run, Senesi releases Solanke through the centre and into Liverpool's area.
Though the striker then goes down under pressure, claims for a penalty are muted and play continues.
Having brought down Alexander-Arnold as Liverpool try to strike on the counter, Anthony is shown a yellow card.

LIVERPOOL PULL LEVEL! Played in by Jota's deflected pass from the right, Diaz flicks the ball up for himself and crashes past a helpless Neto to level the game up at 1-1! With great speed of thought, the winger skilfully steers the ball home from close range and brings the Anfield crowd to its feet.
With his second goal of the 2023-24 season, Diaz has now scored three times in two Premier League appearances against Bournemouth - and there's still an hour left on the clock here.
Receiving the ball from Jota just outside the box, Salah slices his shot on the turn and sees it spiral well over the crossbar.
PENALTY FOR LIVERPOOL! As Szoboszlai sneaks into the box from the right, Rothwell clumsily sticks out a leg and there's enough contact between the players to cause the Liverpool man to tumble.
The referee does not hesitate - it's a penalty!
For his protests about Liverpool's penalty award, Neto is the latest player booked.
Striking towards the bottom-right corner from the penalty spot, Salah sees his shot saved by Neto, before reacting first to steer in the rebound.
Though Neto makes a superb save to keep Salah's penalty out, he then has to pick the ball out of the net when the Liverpool forward rams home the follow-up finish.

LIVERPOOL TURN IT ROUND! At the second attempt, Salah hauls his side in front! Though his penalty-kick is initially saved by Neto in the bottom-right corner, he pounces on the loose ball from the rebound to make it 2-1 to Liverpool!
Though he didn't score in either meeting with the Cherries last season, Salah has now netted nine goals in nine Premier League appearances against Bournemouth.
Liverpool are pushing forward in search of a third goal, as the Anfield crowd starts to relax and transmit its belief that their team are firmly in charge now, following a particularly shaky start.
Patiently keeping possession inside Liverpool's half, Bournemouth relieve the pressure on their area for a while, as they seek to steady the ship.
Iraola likes his team to prioritise retaining the ball, and they are trying their best to do so.
SAVE! Diaz threads a low pass across the box for Alexander-Arnold, who suddenly appears on the right.
The latter strikes at goal with his left foot, forcing Neto into a stop which sees the ball turned wide for a corner.
In the second of at least four added minutes, Neto neatly sidesteps intense pressure from Gakpo inside his area and then manages to pick out a Bournemouth team-mate.
MISS! Konate's wait for a first Liverpool goal goes on, as he rises highest at the back post following a cross from the right but plants his header over the crossbar!
Semenyo tries his luck from a few yards outside the box, but his low shot sails straight at Alisson in the centre of Liverpool's goal.
HALF-TIME: LIVERPOOL 2-1 BOURNEMOUTH
Despite taking an early lead to capitalise on their hosts' defensive errors, Bournemouth trail at the break as Liverpool fight back from behind at Anfield.

The Reds struggled for rhythm and were caught out on several occasions in the opening stages, but striking twice - through a smart Diaz finish and Salah's follow-up from a missed penalty - then put them in front.
It's been an open encounter so far, but the home side have certainly had far more possession and goal attempts.
Remarkably, Liverpool are unbeaten in their last 124 Premier League matches when leading at half-time, winning 114 occasions.
That run dates back to December 2016, when they were beaten by none other than Bournemouth.
Furthermore, the Reds haven’t lost their first Premier League home game in any of the last 19 seasons.
Bournemouth kick off, and we are back under way at Anfield!
After Alexander-Arnold sees a shot from the edge of the area charged down following a well-worked routine from a corner-kick, Liverpool maintain their pressure on the Bournemouth box.
CLOSE! Having shrugged off both Konate and Mac Allister in midfield and then continued his run to the brink of the box, Semenyo unleashes a powerful swerving shot that zips just over the crossbar!
Unable to get over the ball, Jota nods well wide of the target following Robertson's inswinging corner from the right.
Then, just seconds later, he steers a wayward half-volley over the top following a shoddy clearance by Neto.

SAVE! A tame shot by Salah allows Neto to drop down and gather the ball at his near post, just when it seemed that Bournemouth would go two goals behind! Gakpo slipped his team-mate through with a low pass, but the Egyptian winger was indecisive with his finish.
Gakpo has a couple of shots blocked, as Liverpool continue to probe for a potentially decisive third goal.
There's been some brave last-ditch defending by Bournemouth in this second half.
Bournemouth simply can't retain possession long enough to break Liverpool's utter dominance of this second half.
Momentum is with the home side now, as Jota has a low shot on the turn blocked at close range.

OFF! After arriving late into a studs-up challenge on Christie just outside Bournemouth's box, Mac Allister is shown a straight red card! He caught his opponent's boot, but it wasn't malicious - nonetheless, he has to walk, and Liverpool are now down to 10 men!
To their credit, Liverpool are still pushing forward in search of a third goal, despite being reduced to 10 players by Mac Allister's shock dismissal.

LIVERPOOL STRIKE! Making light of being one man down, the home side actually extend their lead! Within minutes of Mac Allister's sending-off, Szoboszlai drives in a low shot from outside the area, which Neto can only parry straight into the path of Jota, who then prods it over the line: 3-1 to Liverpool!
To cover for a lack of numbers in central midfield, Gakpo is withdrawn and Endo comes on to make his Liverpool debut.
Now with a mountain to climb, Bournemouth make a double substitution: First, Christie makes way for Moore.
Kluivert replaces Anthony for the final half-hour.
Soon after his error allowed Liverpool to stretch their lead to two goals, Neto has to scramble the ball clear following a mix-up with his defensive colleagues.
The Bournemouth skipper is enduring a tough couple of minutes here.
Semenyo cuts in from the right flank and sends over an inswinging cross towards the back post for Moore, but it's overhit and instead runs behind for a goal-kick.

CLOSE! After Senesi is left bamboozled by Jota's quick feet and the Liverpool forward breaks through into the six-yard box before testing Neto, Moore then fails to make clean contact with the ball at the other end.
It's wide open now!
Once again, Semenyo drives in from the right flank, and this time his pass is perfectly weighted for Moore, who pops up near the penalty spot.
However, the big striker leans back on his shot and sends the ball careering over the crossbar.
From a long ball forward, Solanke takes the ball down expertly with his chest, but just as he is about to shoot the referee blows his whistle for a minor push on Konate just outside the area.
Liverpool are making a clear effort to retain possession and kill off any hopes of a late Bournemouth comeback.
Despite going down to 10 men in this second half, they've continued to pose a real threat on the break.
To see his side over the line, Klopp opts for two more changes.
First, Alexander-Arnold is replaced by Gomez at right-back.
Jota is also withdrawn, as Elliott comes on to replace him.
Iraola also makes a double substitution.
First, Rothwell comes off and Kelly is sent on.
Opening goalscorer Semenyo is also taken off; Brooks is sent on to help save the game.
Continuing to run down the clock, Liverpool are keeping the ball inside their own half; much to Bournemouth's frustration.
A good chance is spurned by Solanke, who powers in from the left before slashing his 18-yard shot well wide of the right-hand post.
Ignoring options to both his left and right, Salah surges through the centre towards Bournemouth's box and then drags a low shot wide of the right-hand post.
A final throw of the dice by Iraola: Senesi is taken off, to be replaced by a forward - Traore comes on.

GOOD STOP! Alisson stands strong to parry away a close-range strike by Kluivert! The Bournemouth substitute perhaps should have found the far corner, but when his shot arrived at pace Liverpool's goalkeeper was equal to it.
As Diaz has apparently picked up a muscular injury, Liverpool's opening goalscorer must be withdrawn; Nunez replaces him for the final few minutes.
In a more measured fashion than last week at Chelsea, Salah now departs.
Tsimikas comes on in his place.
Bournemouth simply can't sustain enough possession to pin Liverpool back - despite having a one-man advantage.
Can they score even once, to make the closing stages more interesting?

From a 25-yard free-kick in a central position, Billing steps up and laces a wild shot well over the crossbar; summing up Bournemouth's fortunes in the final third since going ahead in the third minute.
SAVE! After taking one touch inside to set himself, Traore lines up a thunderous 20-yard strike at goal; forcing Alisson to tip the ball over for a Bournemouth corner!

SHARP STOP! Traore forces another save from Alisson, this time sending the Brazilian down to his left to repel a shot sent towards the bottom corner! The former Sassuolo winger has made quite an impression since leaving the bench.
FULL-TIME: LIVERPOOL 3-1 BOURNEMOUTH
Recovering from a shaky start in which Bournemouth deservedly went ahead, Liverpool win their first home game of the new Premier League season quite comfortably.

After dragging themselves back into a match they eventually dominated - even when reduced to 10 players by Mac Allister's second-half dismissal - the Reds sealed three points with Jota's second-half strike, as they truly settled into their rhythm.
Victory stretches their unbeaten run in the top flight to 13 games, while the Cherries still seek a first win of the season.
Following an entertaining encounter today, Liverpool visit Newcastle next, while Bournemouth will aim to end their winless streak at home to Tottenham next weekend.
That's all from Anfield today, so thank you for joining us and goodbye!
